schema.description: Request schema for creating a booking link

client_id.description: The ID of a client to pre-select on the link.

expires_at.description: When the link should stop accepting new bookings.

locked_fields.description: Fields the public booker may not change on begotten booking intents.

max_uses.description: How many confirmed bookings the link may beget. Omit for unlimited.

name.description: An optional label for the link.

provider_ids.description: The provider subset the link is restricted to. Omit or pass an empty array to use the full service rotation.

service_id.description: The ID of the service to create the link on.

schema.title: CreateBookingLinkRequest
